purpose: Separate wide-cache admission interference from lack of arithmetic sharing in the fixed Phi-basis / Prosperity signed-residual fusion.
single_shared_wide_port: All B/R reads and writes are serial events on the same physical 1RW address space; the split gives no additional port.
shadow_policy: Cold per tile, LRU on actual shadow insertion/exact occurrence and selected compatible touch. Query the prior shadow snapshot before inserting current R. Cache nonzero signed masks with popcount >=2 only. Saturate count at 3. Record all scans/comparisons and metadata updates.
all_policy: Admit every newly formed residual with >=2 terms; exact wide hits do not rewrite.
exact_second: If current nontrivial R already occurred in the prior shadow table, admit its completed value after normal construction, including construction from an existing wide parent. Otherwise only update the narrow shadow table.
compatible_second: Strict extension of exact_second. Keep its complete-R admission. Only if exact_second would not admit and no wide residual parent exists, choose the largest proper same-sign subset P in the prior shadow table (lexicographic positive/negative-mask tie), build P in Reg2, write P, then append R-P without another residual write. At most one residual materialization per row. Hold Reg2 until P write completes. Tag updates happen after this decision.
base_policy: Identical to the sealed model: admit fetched/constructed nontrivial bases; one static largest proper subset-center parent, used only when already resident; no recursive parent construction.
wide_replacement: Actual reads and new writes update LRU. Partitioned policies evict only within their B or R allocation; common policies share one LRU. Tag probes are not wide reads.
oracle_boundaries: C128 is only a capacity relaxation of the same native order, centers and parent rule. Future-unused-write elision deletes writes never read later in that same no-eviction trace; it is an unrealizable diagnostic lower bound for that trace, not a fair implementation or global optimum.
strong_baseline: Original full-tile Prosperity clean-room subset relation with official artifact minimum-index tie, popcount/index topological order and live-parent writes. Count its arithmetic, unique coefficient identities, reads, writes and peak live state; different scheduling is disclosed, not an iso-area cycle claim.
numeric_check: Reuse sealed eight-lane INT8-weight / non-1 rational-threshold diagnostics. Verify full destination result, not only residual. No checkpoint FP32 or AEE claim.
gate: Do not advance the fixed routing as a headline based solely on beating a weakened independent-residual baseline. If even the capacity relaxation loses original Prosperity arithmetic, cache policy cannot establish its arithmetic advantage on this cohort. Event counts are not cycles, PPA or RTL speedup.
